assembly_instructions: 1. Place open_frame_base on the floor at world y=0 and bolt the left/right/rear/front base rails, two base outriggers, and four vertical posts through the base plate. 2. Add rear and front top cross rails, left and right top side rails, and the four diagonal braces so the rack is square but still open for inspection. 3. Mount input_plate, embedding_table, and residual_spine on the centerline; the spine is the assembly datum for every sampled transformer cartridge. 4. Stack the twelve visible layer cartridges on the residual spine in the 3:1 cadence: three brass DeltaNet cartridges followed by one copper softmax cartridge, repeated at the bottom and top samples to stand for 192 layers. 5. Attach one narrow layer tap to each visible cartridge, then connect DeltaNet taps to the left service arm and softmax taps to the right service arm. 6. Build the left DeltaNet subassembly from its support posts, qkv gate projection, kernel block, fixed state torus, state memory capsule, and output projection; connect its output back to the residual spine. 7. Build the right softmax subassembly from its support posts, QKV projection, QK-Norm cylinder, RoPE ring, attention plate, output gate, KV cache tower, four 64K cache slices, DCA plate, and YaRN plate. 8. Bolt the MoE bridge to the right side of the layer stack, install router, dispatch manifold, eight active expert cartridges, four open inactive-expert bank shelves, combine manifold, and all-to-all communication ring. 9. Install the top output deck, MTP head, LM loss marker, /think and /no_think mode plates, and connect them to the final softmax layer and residual spine. 10. Add training_data_pipe, optimizer_adamw, post_train_pipeline, and the TP/EP/PP/DP rear backplane; verify every non-root subsystem connects visibly to the frame, residual spine, cache tower, or MoE manifolds without any opaque enclosure hiding two or more internal parts.

info.summary: PROJECTED next-generation flagship from Alibaba's Qwen team, extrapolated from the Qwen3 + Qwen3-Next research direction. No public paper at scene time. Best guess: scales Qwen3-Next's hybrid Gated DeltaNet (linear) + Gated Attention (softmax) pattern to flagship size. ~480B total / ~30B activated, 192 layers, 3:1 LINEAR:SOFTMAX attention ratio, 256 routed experts (top-8, no shared), QK-Norm + RoPE on softmax layers, MTP head, /think + /no_think modes preserved, 256K native context (1M with DCA + YaRN), 200+ languages. Treat numbers as plausible extrapolation, not fact.
info.description:
Qwen3.6 is presented here as a research-trajectory PROJECTION, not a paper. Where Qwen3-235B-A22B was full softmax + GQA(64/4) + 128 experts top-8, and where Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B introduced the Gated DeltaNet linear-attention + Gated Attention hybrid at small scale, Qwen3.6 likely (i) brings that hybrid to flagship scale (480B-A30B), (ii) doubles depth (94 → 192 layers — Qwen3-Next is already 48 layers narrow), (iii) doubles expert count (128 → 256), (iv) keeps GQA at extreme 16:1 in the few softmax layers, (v) adds an MTP head (Qwen3 lacked one; Qwen3-Coder added one — full family adoption), (vi) extends native context 32K → 256K with DCA + YaRN reaching 1M, (vii) keeps /think + /no_think system-tag modes preserved.

Design rationale, in one line each:
• Gated DeltaNet (linear): O(N) attention for 75% of layers — KV-cache memory scales with layer count, not context length, on those layers.
• Keep some softmax: pure linear attention loses associative recall (the 'needle in a haystack' problem); 1-in-4 softmax layer restores it.
• Doubled experts (256): adds capacity at the same active-FLOPs budget.
• MTP added: ~1.8× speculative decoding for free.
• 192 layers: Qwen3-Next showed deep-narrow scaling holds; flagship inherits.

facts.label: context length
facts.value: 256 K native, 1 M with DCA + YaRN

facts.label: softmax heads
facts.value: 64 Q / 4 KV (GQA, ratio 16 — kept from Qwen3)

facts.label: precision
facts.value: FP8 GEMMs + BF16 master, INT4 KV (projected)

comparisons.delta: Qwen3-235B was full-softmax GQA(64/4) + 128 experts top-8 + no MTP, 94 layers. Projected Qwen3.6 doubles total params (235B → 480B), modestly grows activated (22B → 30B), DOUBLES depth (94 → 192), DOUBLES experts (128 → 256), introduces the 3:1 linear/softmax hybrid borrowed from Qwen3-Next, adds an MTP head, and pushes context from 32K-trained / 128K-extended to 256K-trained / 1M-extended. /think+/no_think modes preserved.

Qwen3-Next was the small (80B-A3B) Qwen3 prototype that introduced Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention at a 3:1 ratio over 48 layers. Qwen3.6 is the FLAGSHIP scaling of that recipe: 6× total params, 10× activated, 4× layers, but the same 3:1 hybrid pattern and the same DeltaNet kernel. Like Qwen3-Next, no shared expert.

Both are hybrid-attention reasoning MoEs. MiniMax pushes lightning attention to extreme ratios (projected 11:1 lightning:softmax). Qwen3.6 stays moderate at 3:1 — more softmax layers means better short-context quality at higher long-context KV cost. Qwen3.6's linear kernel is Gated DeltaNet (delta-rule with gating); MiniMax uses the Transnormer-style right-product linear attention. Different bets on the linear-attention design space.

V4-Pro keeps full-softmax everywhere but compresses + sparsifies via CSA + HCA + lightning indexer + top-k=1024. Qwen3.6 takes the orthogonal route: replace 75% of attention with O(N) linear attention. Both reach 1M-class context but with different cost profiles — V4 is read-bandwidth-bound on the indexer GEMM, Qwen3.6 is sequential-state-update-bound on the DeltaNet layers.

parts.name: Open Computation Frame Base
parts.role: Thin floor plate roots the assembly at y=0 while leaving transformer, attention, and MoE internals visible above it.

parts.name: Left Service Rail
parts.role: Left rail carries DeltaNet support posts and keeps the linear-attention state hardware outside the layer stack.

parts.name: Right Service Rail
parts.role: Right rail supports the softmax cache and MoE dispatch modules outside the residual tower.

parts.name: Rear Cross Rail
parts.role: Rear cross rail squares the base and anchors the distributed-parallelism backplane.

parts.name: Front Open Cross Rail
parts.role: Low front rail ties the two front posts without blocking the view into token input and embedding stages.

parts.name: Left Module Outrigger
parts.role: Floor outrigger braces the external DeltaNet modules so they do not appear to float off the frame.

parts.name: Right Module Outrigger
parts.role: Floor outrigger carries the external softmax cache tower and MoE expert rack.

parts.name: Front Left Frame Post
parts.role: Front-left post defines the open rack height while keeping the cartridge faces exposed.

parts.name: Front Right Frame Post
parts.role: Front-right post supports the MoE bridge side while leaving the front inspection face open.

parts.name: Rear Left Frame Post
parts.role: Rear-left post gives the tower depth and supports the rear execution backplane.

parts.name: Rear Right Frame Post
parts.role: Rear-right post ties the softmax and MoE side modules back to the main frame.

parts.name: Rear Top Output Cross Rail
parts.role: Rear top rail ties the rear posts and carries the back edge of the output deck.

parts.name: Front Top Output Cross Rail
parts.role: Front top rail completes the open rectangular frame without forming an opaque cover.

parts.name: Left Top Side Rail
parts.role: Left side rail locks the two left posts while leaving the DeltaNet modules visible below it.

parts.name: Right Top Side Rail
parts.role: Right side rail braces the softmax cache and MoE side of the frame.

parts.name: Front Left Diagonal Brace
parts.role: Slim diagonal brace triangulates the front-left bay without hiding the layer cartridges.

parts.name: Front Right Diagonal Brace
parts.role: Slim diagonal brace supports the MoE side while preserving the front cutaway.

parts.name: Rear Left Diagonal Brace
parts.role: Rear-left brace stabilizes the frame behind the residual tower.

parts.name: Rear Right Diagonal Brace
parts.role: Rear-right brace stabilizes the softmax and expert side of the frame.

parts.name: Input Tokens (V≈152K, 200+ langs)
parts.role: Multilingual BPE token floor where token ids enter before embedding lookup.

parts.name: Embedding Table (V≈152K, d=4096)
parts.role: Tied embedding lookup converts token ids into the d=4096 residual stream before the first layer.

parts.name: Residual Stream Spine (d=4096)
parts.role: Central vertical residual path through the projected 192 pre-norm transformer layers.

parts.name: Layer Ruler: 192 Total
parts.role: Scale bar marks that the twelve visible cartridges are samples of 192 total layers.

parts.name: Layer 001 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: First visible Gated DeltaNet block uses linear recurrent attention instead of a context-length KV cache.

parts.name: Layer 002 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Second linear block in the repeating three-linear sequence.

parts.name: Layer 003 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Third linear block before the first full softmax recovery layer.

parts.name: Layer 004 - SOFTMAX Gated Attention
parts.role: First full attention layer restores associative recall with GQA 64Q/4KV and a gated output.

parts.name: Layer 005 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Linear layer sample shows the repeated DeltaNet path after a softmax recovery layer.

parts.name: Layer 006 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Middle DeltaNet layer sample in the second 3:1 attention group.

parts.name: Layer 007 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Third DeltaNet layer before the second softmax sample.

parts.name: Layer 008 - SOFTMAX Gated Attention
parts.role: Second visible softmax recovery layer, one of the projected 48 softmax layers.

parts.name: Layer 189 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Compressed top-of-stack sample shows that late layers still follow the linear-attention majority.

parts.name: Layer 190 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Late-stage DeltaNet layer sample immediately below the final pair.

parts.name: Layer 191 - LINEAR DeltaNet
parts.role: Final linear layer sample before the last softmax layer.

parts.name: Layer 192 - Final SOFTMAX
parts.role: Final attention layer before the tied LM head preserves associative recall at the top of the stack.

parts.name: Layer 001 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Narrow tap makes the first linear layer's service connection visible outside the cartridge stack.

parts.name: Layer 002 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Narrow tap links the second linear layer to the shared DeltaNet kernel path.

parts.name: Layer 003 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Narrow tap shows the third linear layer feeding recurrent state before softmax recovery.

parts.name: Layer 004 Softmax Tap
parts.role: Softmax tap routes the fourth layer out to QK-Norm, RoPE, and the KV cache tower.

parts.name: Layer 005 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Narrow tap re-enters the DeltaNet side after the first softmax layer.

parts.name: Layer 006 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Narrow tap links the sixth layer to the fixed-size DeltaNet memory capsule.

parts.name: Layer 007 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Narrow tap connects the seventh layer to the DeltaNet output projection.

parts.name: Layer 008 Softmax Tap
parts.role: Softmax tap shows the second recovery layer sharing the KV cache tower.

parts.name: Layer 189 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Late-stack tap makes the sampled top DeltaNet block visibly share the same linear path.

parts.name: Layer 190 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Late-stack tap connects the penultimate DeltaNet memory path.

parts.name: Layer 191 DeltaNet Tap
parts.role: Final DeltaNet tap shows the linear path returning before the last softmax layer.

parts.name: Layer 192 Softmax Tap
parts.role: Final softmax tap connects the top attention layer to output gating and long-context cache.

parts.name: DeltaNet Lower Support Post
parts.role: Lower post carries the left-side DeltaNet plates from the base outrigger up to the service arm.

parts.name: DeltaNet Upper Support Post
parts.role: Upper post braces the DeltaNet kernel, state ring, and output projection so the subassembly reads as mounted hardware.

parts.name: DeltaNet Service Arm
parts.role: Cantilever arm physically connects the left-side DeltaNet modules and all linear-layer taps to the frame.

parts.name: DeltaNet QKV plus Alpha-Gate Projection
parts.role: Projection tile emits Q, K, V, and a sigmoid alpha gate for each token before recurrent state update.

parts.name: Gated DeltaNet Kernel
parts.role: Linear attention kernel applies the delta-rule state update with per-token cost independent of context length.
parts.bottleneck: Sequential state update during decode; chunked prefill recovers partial parallelism.

parts.name: Fixed-Size DeltaNet State Ring
parts.role: Visible ring marks the recurrent S state that replaces a long KV cache for 144 linear layers.
parts.memory_footprint: ≈1 MB per sequence per layer, independent of token count

parts.name: DeltaNet State Memory Capsule
parts.role: Compact memory vessel shows that DeltaNet storage scales with layers and batch, not context length.

parts.name: DeltaNet Output Projection
parts.role: Projects DeltaNet output back to d=4096 before the residual add.

parts.name: Softmax Lower Support Post
parts.role: Lower support post carries the right-side softmax inspection modules from the outrigger to the service arm.

parts.name: Softmax Cache Support Post
parts.role: Cache support post visually anchors the KV tower and long-context plates to the base.

parts.name: Softmax Service Arm
parts.role: Right-side arm connects softmax taps, QKV projection, and attention plate to the frame and cache tower.

parts.name: Softmax QKV Projection GQA 64Q/4KV
parts.role: Projection tile generates 64 query heads and 4 shared KV heads for the softmax layers.

parts.name: QK-Norm Stage
parts.role: Normalizes query and key vectors before rotary position embedding is applied.

parts.name: RoPE Rotary Position Ring
parts.role: Rotary ring marks position encoding on softmax Q and K streams before attention.

parts.name: Gated Softmax Attention Plate
parts.role: Full causal softmax attention plate for the 48 recovery layers that retain associative recall.

parts.name: Softmax KV Cache Tower
parts.role: Visible cache tower stores GQA KV tensors only for the 48 softmax layers.

parts.name: KV Cache Slice 0-64K
parts.role: First visible cache slice represents the initial 64K portion of native 256K context.

parts.name: KV Cache Slice 64-128K
parts.role: Second visible cache slice represents the next 64K native context segment.

parts.name: KV Cache Slice 128-192K
parts.role: Third visible cache slice represents the 128K to 192K context range.

parts.name: KV Cache Slice 192-256K
parts.role: Fourth visible cache slice completes the projected 256K native window.

parts.name: Softmax Output Gate
parts.role: Learned gate scales the softmax attention output before returning it to the residual stream.

parts.name: DCA plus YaRN Long-Context Module
parts.role: Open top rail groups the DCA and YaRN plates that extend softmax attention from 256K native to projected 1M context.

parts.name: Dual-Chunk Attention Window Plate
parts.role: DCA plate depicts chunked attention scheduling used to make million-token softmax windows tractable.

parts.name: YaRN RoPE Scaling Plate
parts.role: YaRN plate marks rotary-position scaling that extrapolates context beyond the native training window.

parts.name: Per-Layer MoE Bridge
parts.role: Vertical bridge shows that every transformer layer routes through a per-layer sparse MoE feed-forward block.

parts.name: Top-8 Softmax Router
parts.role: Router disk scores 256 experts and selects the top eight for each token with loss-free balance bias.

parts.name: Expert Dispatch Manifold
parts.role: NCCL dispatch bar sends token groups from the router to the selected expert cartridges.

parts.name: Expert Rack Front Post
parts.role: Front post anchors the open expert rack and keeps active cartridges in a readable plane.

parts.name: Expert Rack Rear Post
parts.role: Rear post carries the inactive expert shelves without covering the active top-8 route.

parts.name: Active Expert 1 of Top-8
parts.role: First selected SwiGLU expert cartridge from the projected 256 routed experts.

parts.name: Active Expert 2 of Top-8
parts.role: Second selected expert shows top-8 activation rather than a single shared expert.

parts.name: Active Expert 3 of Top-8
parts.role: Third selected SwiGLU expert carries intermediate dimension around 1536.

parts.name: Active Expert 4 of Top-8
parts.role: Fourth selected expert participates in the per-token sparse feed-forward path.

parts.name: Active Expert 5 of Top-8
parts.role: Fifth selected expert cartridge makes the top-8 routing count visible.

parts.name: Active Expert 6 of Top-8
parts.role: Sixth selected expert contributes to the activated 30B-parameter token path.

parts.name: Active Expert 7 of Top-8
parts.role: Seventh active expert is separated from the inactive bank to avoid hiding the sparse route.

parts.name: Active Expert 8 of Top-8
parts.role: Eighth selected expert completes the top-8 sparse activation set.

parts.name: Inactive Expert Bank Shelf 1
parts.role: First open shelf represents a quarter of the 248 inactive experts without hiding the active top-8 cartridges.
parts.memory_footprint: ≈62 inactive experts represented on this shelf

parts.name: Inactive Expert Bank Shelf 2
parts.role: Second open shelf marks more parked experts while preserving a cutaway view through the rack.
parts.memory_footprint: ≈62 inactive experts represented on this shelf

parts.name: Inactive Expert Bank Shelf 3
parts.role: Third open shelf shows unused expert capacity as a rack rather than a featureless opaque disk.
parts.memory_footprint: ≈62 inactive experts represented on this shelf

parts.name: Inactive Expert Bank Shelf 4
parts.role: Fourth open shelf completes the remaining 248-of-256 expert pool representation.
parts.memory_footprint: Total MoE bank ≈256 × 3·d·d_ff × BF16 ≈9.3 GiB per layer

parts.name: Expert Combine Manifold
parts.role: Combine bar gathers weighted expert outputs and sends them back to the residual stream.

parts.name: Expert All-to-All Communication Ring
parts.role: Copper ring represents the NCCL all-to-all network used for expert dispatch and combine.

parts.name: Tied LM Head
parts.role: Tied output projection maps the final residual state back to the approximately 152K-token vocabulary.

parts.name: MTP Head Depth 1
parts.role: Projected multi-token prediction head supports speculative decoding with one extra future-token target.

parts.name: LM Loss and Reward Head Marker
parts.role: Small output marker represents next-token cross-entropy during pre-training and reward-optimized post-training objectives.

parts.name: Mode Plate: /think
parts.role: System-tag mode plate indicates reasoning traces are enabled while using the same shared weights.

parts.name: Mode Plate: /no_think
parts.role: System-tag mode plate indicates direct-answer decoding while preserving the same model weights.

parts.name: ~50T-Token Multilingual Data Pipe
parts.role: Input-side data pipe represents the projected 50T-token multilingual pre-training corpus.

parts.name: AdamW Optimizer Module
parts.role: Training-side module represents AdamW with sharded optimizer state across data-parallel workers.

parts.name: Optimizer Support Bracket
parts.role: Vertical bracket grounds the AdamW module to the left service rail and prevents it reading as a floating block.

parts.name: SFT, RLHF, Reasoning-RL and Long-Output RL
parts.role: Post-training pipeline module refines instruction following, reasoning mode, and long-output behavior after pre-training.

parts.name: Post-Training Support Bracket
parts.role: Tall bracket ties the elevated post-training module to the left frame rail and top brace.

parts.name: TP x EP x PP x DP Backplane
parts.role: Rear backplane labels the distributed execution plan tying tensor, expert, pipeline, and data parallelism together.
